spec.description: The NOAA Weather Radio transmitters that broadcast for a county. JSON-LD, not GeoJSON: the transmitters come as a `@graph`.

zone_type.description: The zone type. Only `county`: the OpenAPI lists every zone type, but the service refuses any other with a 404 naming `county` as the one value it takes.

response.title: TransmitterCollection
response.description: The transmitters, as a JSON-LD graph.

@graph.description: The transmitters. Each one arrives many times over, identical: 64 copies of each on 2026-09-30.

setId.description: Which release of the transmitter list this came from.

siteName.description: Name of the transmitter, such as `Seattle`.

sameCodes.description: SAME codes of the counties it broadcasts for: `0`, the FIPS state, the FIPS county, such as `053033`.

counties.description: County zone codes it broadcasts for, such as `WAC033`, in the order of `sameCodes`.

notes: TRU-414 excluded the other `/radio` operation it met, `/points/{point}/radio`, as XML-only. This one answers `application/ld+json` whatever the `Accept` header asks for (measured 2026-09-30 with `application/geo+json`, `application/ld+json` and `*/*`).

The service repeats every transmitter: `/zones/county/WAC033/radio` held `KHB60` 64 times and nothing else, `/zones/county/ALC001/radio` three transmitters 64 times each, all identical. The spec describes the wire, so the repeats are in the recording and in what the client returns.
